text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Each model was trained once, on one year of data. Dot: mean difference. Line: interval from resampling whole calendar months (98.3% for all 13 series, 95% for the other rows). Zero: same score as the model trained on 2024-07 to 2025-06. Above zero: the old year is worse. Raw: trained on demand as measured. Level removed: trained after subtracting the 365-day average.'
text.tspan: 13 primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Each model was trained once, on one year of data.
Dot: mean difference. Line: interval from resampling whole calendar months
(98.3% for all 13 series, 95% for the other rows). Zero: same score as the model
trained on 2024-07 to 2025-06. Above zero: the old year is worse. Raw: trained on
demand as measured. Level removed: trained after subtracting the 365-day average.
